batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b Anureet Singh

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b Gurkeerat Singh

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b GJ Maxwell

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b BE Hendricks

batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b AR Patel

batting.name: PP Chawla
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b Anureet Singh

balls.text: a full toss outside off stump, Miller is around leg so he has room to reach for the ball and slap it through point to drive Kings XI past 180 ... massive final over for Kings XI, 21 off it
Russell responds with a short ball and Miller counters with a hook, he gets a top edge but the fielder at fine leg is in the circle, so that's a one-bounce four
Miller had crossed over to take the strike and he cashes in! Clears his front leg, stays low by staying inside his crease, gets under a full ball and drills it flat over wide long-on for six

caught and bowled! Russell's short ball is too quick for Gurkeerat, who swivels towards the off and tries to pull. He gets a top edge that lobs towards short leg, Russell runs across and catches it easily
short of a length and Miller is late on the pull again, he gets an inside edge on to his body and the ball rolls on the off side
length outside off, plenty of hitting space for Miller who frees his arms and slams the ball flat and hard over long off
that's a high full toss and Miller is once again late on the shot, he ends up slicing it over the bowler's head and the ball falls safe before long-off can get to it
he hits it on the leg side for a single towards mid-on
in the blockhole again, not letting Miller get under it and free his arms, he squeezes it out behind point for just the single
in the blockhole on middle and off, Miller digs it out on the leg side
Uthappa does really well to dive full length to his left and stop a really wide ball from Umesh
a full toss around off stump, it was on to Miller quicker than he was prepared for and he ended up mis-timing it to long off
full ball on off and middle, the batsman goes deep into his crease to drive to long on
a low full toss hit through square leg for a single
pushed through cover for a single
steps out to defend because he doesn't really know what the ball is going to do off the pitch, it's the googly from Hogg and it rips past the outside edge of a tentative prod
Miller tries to sweep a low full toss but misses and is hit low on the pad, huge appeal for lbw but the impact might have been outside off stump, it was
strides forward and spoons the cover drive in the air but through the gap in the infield
Miller gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball from outside off behind square
Narine has his fourth wicket! Saha gets down on one knee to slog across the line but the length is quick and the pace is faster, it sneaks under his bat and bowls him
short ball, Saha rocks back and pulls the ball far over the deep midwicket boundary
a huge appeal for lbw, the batsman moves right across his stumps to glance but misses, that looks really good because you can see leg stump, not given, Uthappa could have run out Saha as well

finally they have caught one! Maxwell top edges a pull - the ball might have bounced a bit more than expected - and  Botha comes running in from the deep midwicket boundary to take a well-judged catch. Once he has it safely, he celebrates with a rugby-like kick
Saha mows across the line, a bit of a slog that was, dragging the straighter one from far outside off through the leg side
the offbreak spins into Maxwell, who moves back and across in his crease to play off the pads through midwicket
full toss on the pads, Saha misses an easy one, he tried to hit it too hard and did not connect
backs away towards leg and slaps a full ball towards deep point
defended on the leg side
too full on the pads, Maxwell glances it fine to the fine leg boundary

that's an amazing effort from Botha at mid-off! Saha hit a full toss flat and hard towards mid-off and Botha came flying to his right with a full length dive, a lot of fielders wouldn't have got a hand on that chance
in the blockhole, Maxwell stays balanced in his crease and clips it through square leg
a full toss and Saha nails it, getting squared up on one knee and mowing the ball over deep midwicket for another six
bowled full outside off stump, Maxwell tries to reverse hit but misses and the ball hits the keeper and bounces away for a bye on the off side
Hogg beats Maxwell on the front-foot lunge with the googly that spins away from the right-hander, Maxwell gets his back foot behind the crease in the nick of time before Uthappa breaks the stumps
that's a long hop and it's in the stands beyond deep midwicket, Maxwell rocks back and has time to free his arms and then some, a smooth pull
another reverse sweep, along the ground this time and he beats short third man for another boundary
bowled full on middle and off, Mawell gets on the front foot and lofts the ball firmly to long on, beats the fielder to his left
played off the back foot through cover point for a single
straight down the ground this time, a quick one-two out of his crease to get to the pitch of the ball and a clean loft over the bowler's head, the ball fell short of the sightscreen
Maxwell plays his reverse sweep, hitting the ball from leg stump with the legspin over the heads of short third man and backward point, really good connection
Saha advances and mows across the line, he is no where near the pitch of the delivery though and gets an inside edge to short fine leg
tossed up on middle stump, Maxwell moves forward and drives the ball extremely hard through midwicket but can't split he gap in the deep
gets down low on the front foot and slog sweeps the legbreak to deep square leg
too short and this time Maxwell is ready and waiting, he pulls the ball over deep midwicket for six, he moved outside off quickly and freed his arms
banged in short, Maxwell tries to pull but is beaten by the pace
short ball, pulled to deep square leg
huge wide down leg side, Saha's pull isn't close to the ball and Uthappa does well to dive to his left and collect
jumps back and opens the face to try and run the ball past the keeper, Uthappa moves to his right to field and misses the stumps at the bowler's end, a better throw would have made Maxwell hurry
a full ball on off stump, driven on the up to mid off
good length on middle and leg, the batsman tries to work it behind square but fails to make proper contact
played to long on for a single
Maxwell strides forward and drives cleanly through cover, he's off the mark with a double, Russell prevents another boundary with terrific ground speed
slog swept to long leg for a single
goes right back into his crease and hits the flat ball from off stump through cover
short ball outside off, cut firmly off the back foot to deep point where Russell thunders across the outfield to prevent the boundary
steps out of his crease and clips the ball off his toes to deep midwicket
drifting onto the pads, Maxwell does not connect with the glance. He weathers the lbw appeal

Return catch, Narine strikes! Vohra is hanging around, though. They go to the TV umpire. This was pushed through flatter and quicker just outside off, he seeks to pull it but does not control it, lobbing it back to the bowler. Narine bends low to complete a clean catch. Umpire Dharmasena raises his forefinger
Narine drops it short and outside off, he rocks back and controls a pull to deep midwicket
tucked away through backward square leg
on a length and on the leg stump, he misses the sweep. I guess he may have got a bit of glove on it
pushed through on off, knocked in front of the covers for one
tossed up legbreak outside off, Vohra swings and only connects with thin air
clean and effective.. Chawla gives this ample air outside off. Vohra, having backed away, has enough leverage to hoist it over the covers. Beats long-off as well
another low full toss, Saha goes low and paddles it behind square leg. Umesh runs across and hauls it in before the boundary
nice and loopy, turns away, dabbed in front of point
fuller and just a shade outside off, Vohra slogs and skews it to short fine leg off a thick inside edge
low full toss on off, Saha takes a couple of paces forward and whips it to long-on
Saha goes right back and pulls the ball to deep square leg, that spun into him
once again he can't read the googly from the hand so he hangs back to see what the ball does off the pitch and then taps it awkwardly on the off side
strays on to the pads and Vohra nudges towards short fine leg
that's the orthodox delivery from Hogg that spins into the right hander, he plays it behind point
the batsman does not pick the googly, he moves back and tries to pull but the ball spins away from him far outside off stump
tries to sweep but the ball is down leg side and too far away
worked off the pads towards short fine leg

dropped again, what on earth is going on! Vohra closed the face too early to a short of a length delivery and got a leading edge towards mid-on. Yusuf was slow to react as he moved from midwicket to mid-on and he barely got hands on it as it fell over his head.
shot! Russell sends another short ball own at Vohra who swivels and hooks with panache, sweet timing and it sails over deep square leg
played from the crease to point
punched on the up over extra cover towards wide long-off, elegant shot

dropped again! The batsman shapes to hook a short ball and gloves it to the keeper Uthappa, who seemed unsighted as the ball lobbed just over his head, he got hands to it but also failed to hold on. That's four drops so far
the batsman makes room by moving outside leg, Russell follows him with a fast short ball, he defends on the off side
Saha strides forward and defends on the off side
short ball, bowled flat outside off stump, Vohra simply chips it towards long off, that was a loose ball and should have been hit for more

that's a big googly and it spins across the right-hander, Vohra does not pick it and attempts to slog across the line, he managed to get his back foot inside the crease before Uthappa broke the stumps
bowled flatter on leg stump, the batsman gets hit on the pad as he tries to glance, Hogg appeals, optimistically
steps forward to a full ball and clips it through square leg for a single
flighted on middle stump, Vohra slogs over midwicket but it falls short of the fielder in the deep
defended on the front foot towards the bowler

Narine takes his butter-fingered fielders out of the picture by hitting Vijay's leg stump! Vijay moved a long way across his stumps and got down on one knee to sweep, he exposed his leg stump and Narine spun the offbreak past his front thigh and hit it
Narine breaks the ball away from the right-hander, Vijay played for offspin and is beaten
width outside off stump and Vijay cuts it late and through the gap at short third man

the third drop of the game, Umesh the culprit at short fine leg. The batsman swept it flat and firmly and dead straight at the fielder, Umesh juggled it several times before it hit the grass. Shocking fielding from KKR
guided towards point off the front foot for a quick single
Vohra ends the over by pressing forward and driving a full ball clean over long-off, not extravagant but it got the job done
bowled flat and down leg side, Botha is lucky the batsman didn't beat short fine leg with his paddle-swat, they run a risky single
bowled flat on off stump, the batsman stays in his crease and plays to cover
bowled full, nearly in the blockhole on middle stump, dug out through midwicket for a single
flicked off the pads towards square leg
moves back and across in his crease and works the ball off his pads to wide mid-on

dropped by Hogg at square leg, the batsman moved forward and across to swat the ball but ended up hitting it in the air towards Hogg's right, he dived and made a mess of it. KKR have been poor today so far, with the ball and in the field
the off break hits the front pad and Narine appeals, might have been high though
that;s the one that goes the other way, the batsman stays back and works the ball in front of square leg
the off break on the pads, glanced towards short fine leg
tries to loft a ball down the ground but mis-hits it towards mid-off, the fielder is in the deep
nudged off the pads to square leg

sublime timing from Vijay, stays in his crease and feasts on another full ball that's too straight, he uses his wrists to flick between midwicket and mid-on and once the ball gets on those practice pitches in the outfield, it screams across the turf to the boundary
driven into the covers but can't pierce the infield
Vijay stays still in his crease now and pounces on the straighter line from Umesh, glancing it off his hips towards the fine leg boundary
shot! Vijay glides outside leg stump with smooth footwork and slaps a short and wide ball high and far over the cover boundary with a full swing of the arms
punched off the back foot with lovely timing but the placement isn't there at cover point
too full and too straight, clipped off the pads to the deep backward square leg boundary
Russell steams in and lets a bouncer rip, the batsman sways out of the line and the keeper has to leap to collect it over his head

short of a length on the hips, with fine line in the circle, that's not a line you want to bowl. The batsman glances it and this outfield is so fast that the ball races away after passing short fine leg
driven towards wide mid-off for a single
played to point from the crease
driven on the up firmly towards short extra cover where Gambhir leaps up to try and catch it, he gets his right hand to it but can't hold on, a tough chance goes down
a full ball angling into the pads, a wristy flick sends it airborne through midwicket, no one in the in field in that region
pushed from the crease towards cover, Umesh starts well, accurate at brisk pace in his first over
short of a length on off stump, Vijay stays back in his crease and defends on the off side
angled into the right-hander from outside off and the ball seams away a touch, Vohra hangs his bat out and opens the face a touch to steer towards third man
hits a good length outside off and the ball holds its line as the batsman prods and is beaten, Umesh got that to bounce nicely
good length around off stump, Vohra gets behind the line and blocks
a length ball on the pads, clipped towards square leg where a fumble allows the single

a leg bye to win it for KKR! Narine misses the flick and the ball goes to square leg off the pad. Narine sets off immediately, the fielder aims for the stumps at the bowler's end but he misses! KKR go top of the table, what a manic finish

caught down the leg side! That would have been wide had Chawla let it go but he tries to glance the short of a length ball and Saha does splendidly to move to his right to catch it. That was so wide outside leg, and he gloved it.
and that's why he did not run! Chawla hammers the full ball far over deep midwicket to tie the scores! He was on the front foot for the full ball and swung hard, superb strike under pressure

it's all happening at Eden Gardens! Anureet bowls it in the blockhole outside leg to counter Chawla's movement outside leg stump. He inside edges the ball on to the pad and the ball rolls towards the bowler. Hogg charges for the single but Chawla sends him back. Anureet rushes to the ball, picks up, turns around and hits the stumps with Hogg well short
Hogg makes room by moving outside leg and hits straight, the bowler gets a hand on the ball but can't save the single
a low full toss on off stump, makes room and slices the ball in front of point
a full ball outside off, Chawla drives along the ground through cover for a single
nearly in the blockhole, Hogg pushes it towards mid-off for one more
driven firmly off the pads towards long on for a single
a full ball on leg and middle, Chawla tries to clip off his toes but misses, the ball goes towards extra cover off the pad, Hogg begins to run but is sent back because the fielder has come rushing in
a full toss outside off stump, Hogg mis-times the hit to long off, gets the single to give the better batsman the strike, it's all he needs to do

Chawla's cracked it hard, over the infield at point, and the ball races to the boundary. Too short and too wide from Hendricks, a poor finish to the over and KKR are ahead in the game after a short setback
short ball outside off, third man is in the circle, and maybe Chawla knows it because he ramps the ball over the infield to the third man boundary
short of a length outside off stump, the batsman cuts the ball in the air behind point
good length on off and middle, chipped towards long off for a single

Botha's been run out by a direct hit! The match is swinging again. Botha played the ball to extra cover and ran, Axar swooped on the ball, picked up and nailed the throw, catching Botha at least a foot and a half short
a good length ball angles into the left-hander and hits Chawla on the pad as he tries to flick
nudged off the pads behind square for a single
caught behind! Russell goes back to cut and gets a thick edge so that's a sharp catch by Saha to his right. He followed the ball superbly. Has Russell done enough to take KKR to the top of the table?
driven to long off for a single
punched off the back foot to cover
plays the reverse paddle to short third man, Russell back on strike

Russell equals the fastest fifty of the season, he gets there by slicing a ball in the air and it falls safely short of mid-on, midwicket can't get to it either, Russell is level with Harbhajan's 19-ball fifty
slogged to long on for a single
my word, Anureet misses his yorker again and the result is a friendly full toss, too easy for Russell who blasts he ball over cow corner into the delirious fans
a low full toss and Russell powers the ball to the midwicket boundary with another fearsome swing of the bat
Botha gets his front foot across to swat on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad

superb yorker to follow, Russell falls over as he digs it out towards the leg side, Botha is running so Russell scrambles to his feet and sprints, he's fast enough to beat Saha's throw even if it had hit at the bowler's end
what a rubbish ball that is, a high full toss from round the wicket, that's almost over the waist too, Russell pulls it away over the long leg boundary
caught behind! The short ball does it for Kings XI. Yusuf tried to ramp this short ball over the keeper and got an edge through to Saha, he almost walks off before the umpire raises the finger
the slower ball but the length is short and the line is outside leg stump, Yusuf helps it on its way to the fine leg boundary to bring up the 50 partnership off 26 balls
bounces Yusuf from round the wicket, the batsman ducks under it
mis-times the heave towards deep midwicket, Miller comes running in from the deep to field
Russell hits it really hard too, a cracking cut through point and the ball speeds to the boundary, the slower ball was a bit too short outside off
short of a length and wide outside off, Yusuf slaps it hard of the back foot but straight to the fielder at deep cover, along the ground
big swipe outside off stump and the ball races off the outside edge to the third man boundary. The first two overs from Axar went for four runs, and now this.
fired down leg side, that's a wide. Saha whipped off the bails and they have appealed for a stumping. Russell's back leg was fine
Russell now! KKR are on the charge, he clears his front leg out of the way and swings hard, hitting the ball dead straight over the bowler's head
flatter and close to off stump, dabbed towards point for a single
slow again outside off with room too free his arms, Yusuf launches the ball over the long-off boundary with a fearsome blow
stays back this time and is beaten by a really slow ball outside off
tossed up on off and middle, Yusuf plants his front foot forward, gets under the ball and hoists it back over the bowler's head for a powerful six
nearly in the blockhole but not quite, Russell cover drives with force but Bailey is in the way in the infield
he has smashed this all right, the length is way too short and Russell murders the pull on the front foot flat over the midwicket boundary, tremendous power
Russell goes back to short-arm pull a short of a length ball, he doesn't hit it cleanly but fine leg is in the circle so the top edge sails towards the boundary
short of a length around middle and off, dragged across the line in front of square
a low full toss, was trying for the yorker, Russell stays low and drives to long off
Russell drives with hard hands at a good length ball outside off and gets a thick outside edge that runs wide of the keeper to the boundary
flatter and faster with a round-arm action, Russell drives to deep cover, only two runs off the over
really slow this time, Russell stays back and defends towards point
Russell stays in his crease and defends on the leg side, tight line and length on middle
slogged through the leg side for a single
pushed off the front foot to cover, Axar is sending them down flat and fast
short ball and Yusuf will feel he missed out there, pulled it straight to midwicket
defended with no footwork on the off side, the bowler runs to his left to field
big spin but the turn takes it far outside leg stump
bowled him! Yadav moved a long way across his stumps, exposing all three, to try and paddle the ball towards short fine leg, the length was too full and it beat the bat and hit the stumps
bowled flatter and quicker, Yusuf hits it through the off side for a single
steps out and clips the ball gently through midwicket to give the strike to Yusuf
tries to repeat the shot but mis-times it along the ground through midwicket
Yusuf winds up and smashes it far over deep midwicket, he got on the front foot with a big stride and swung hard across the line
a full ball angling into the right-hander, nearly in the blockhole, played through midwicket
Yadav gets under a full and slower ball delivered from the back of the hand and lofts it to the long off boundary, that fell a few feet short of the rope
gets off the mark on his fourth ball by steering towards third man
nudged off the hips towards square leg, Hendricks pitched that outside leg short of a length
good length on middle and off, dabbed from the crease towards point, Yusuf wants one but gets sent back
banged in short at Yusuf, who keeps his eye son the ball and sways minimally out of the line
big spin into the right-hander who gets hit on the pad as he tries to play square, loud appeal for lbw but was that turning too much and down leg side?
what a soft dismissal that is! The ball was short and Gambhir went on the back foot and simply lofted it so tamely towards long-on, Vijay came cruising in from the boundary and caught it easily
dabbed off the back foot towards short third man
steps out and tries to tee off, but ends up mis-timing the ball through midwicket
goes deep into his crease to drive the ball through cover
gets down low on the front foot and sweeps towards deep backward square for a single
shorter length, pulled off the back foot through midwicket
goes back into his crease and flicks behind square
steps forward and drives a full ball through wide mid-on

he was timing it so well against the faster bowlers but Pandey has mis-timed this straight to long-on, a soft dismissal really, hit it flat and limply towards Axar. He dragged it from wide outside off
Gambhir moves back to hit the ball but is cramped for room by Maxwell's angle into him from round the wicket, he plays it to midwicket
wide outside off stump, Pandey hits it hard along the ground to long off
spins into the right-hander, he goes back into his crease and opens the face to play towards point
chipped uppishly towards the bowler, Gurkeerat moves to his right to try and catch it, doesn't carry
strays down leg side this time, that's a wide
gets beaten outside off stump
lofted over cover for a single
driven into the covers
played close on the off side, the bowler runs across to field, he then flings the ball at Gambhir who fends it off with his bat, no words are exchanged and they move on quickly
this time he connects with the slog sweep but cant beat square leg
Gambhir plants his foot forward to slog sweep but misses and is hit on the pad, an appeal for lbw but that pitched outside leg
played through midwicket for a single
Pandey gets beaten outside off stump by a delivery that spins sharply away from him, he had pushed forward to defend
Gambhir leans forward to work the ball towards fine leg but misses and is hit on the pad, they run a leg bye to short fine leg
full ball on the pads, Pandey leans forward and clips it in the air over midwicket and to the boundary, took his back leg off the ground as he played the shot for a dash of flair
that's stunning timing again from Pandey, he barely seems to be touching the ball and yet it screams across the outfield to the long off boundary, that was a checked off drive
the bouncer is far too high, wide called
shot! Pandey strides forward and opens up his stance to punch a length ball superbly through cover, splendid timing with economy of movement
Gambhir steps across towards the off side and whips a full ball towards deep square leg
hangs back this time and taps the ball towards mid off for a single
Pandey jumps out of his crease and punches to cover
short of a length on leg and middle, the ball doesn't bounce much and Gambhir jumps back to short-arm pull the ball firmly in front of square leg for four
dabbed past the bowler towards mid on for a single
what timing that is first ball! Simply caresses a length ball from outside off stump on the up through cover point and the ball races away to the boundary
caught at short midwicket! Uthappa simply chips the length ball off his hips in the air, Axar Patel moves forward quickly and dives to take the catch
half-volley with room for plenty of people outside off stump, Uthappa leans into a front foot drive and drills it along the ground through extra cover
Uthappa plays the ball towards short fine leg and runs
Gambhir stays on the back foot and cuts firmly to point, Maxwell makes the save
driven on the up towards extra cover
short ball outside off, Uthappa gets on to the front foot and frees his arms to pull the ball flat over the head of the fielder at mid-on
stays back to open the face and steer a length ball to third man
full ball with lots of width outside off, Gambhir gets under it on the front foot and drives the ball hard over cover for a boundary
played off the back foot into the off side, that was short of a length from Sandeep
poor line, rank ball pitching outside leg stump, Uthappa glances it off his pads to the fine leg boundary
short ball and Gambhir plays a short-arm pull, the fielder at long leg covers good ground to slide and save the boundary
strays on to the pads, it's a short ball as well, Gambhir simply helps it around the corner to the fine leg boundary
defended from the crease into the leg side
good length outside off, pushes forward and opens the face to steer the ball to third man
driven on the up into the covers

a huge appeal for lbw, that looks so good, pitched in line and beats the inside edge of Gambhir's bat as he closes the face to play on the leg side, I can't believe that hasn't been given. Did the umpire think it pitched outside leg? It pitched in line and was going to smash middle stump
gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends
too straight to the left-hander, Gambhir moves forward and across and flicks the ball from leg stump towards fine leg for four
played off the back foot towards cover point and they run a quick single
steps forward and tries to cut but gets a bottom edge into the ground to the keeper
what a ball that is! Hits a good length outside off and jags back sharply at the right-hander, Uthappa came forward to play the ball and was cut in half between bat and body
